LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1ATTENTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening, part of Strand 1 in Grade 6 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we demonstrate attentive listening? 2. When do we use adverbs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. cultivate attentive listening skills for effective communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify vocabulary from a story for comprehension,

   Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. construct sentences using vocabulary and adverbs correctly for expression,

   Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. cultivate attentive listening skills for effective communication.

   Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a story based on the theme and identify vocabulary related to the theme,

2. work collaboratively to pick out adverbs used in the story,

3. make sentences using vocabulary identified,

4. work jointly to make a presentation using vocabulary identified,

5. take notes on the presentations made and give peer reviews,

6. team up to sing songs commonly used in ceremonies and festivals,

7. collaborate with peers to stage the songs during the class exhibitions. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a story based on the theme and identify vocabulary related to the theme,
2. work collaboratively to pick out adverbs used in the story,
3. make sentences using vocabulary identified,
4. work jointly to make a presentation using vocabulary identified,
5. take notes on the presentations made and give peer reviews,
6. team up to sing songs commonly used in ceremonies and festivals,
7. collaborate with peers to stage the songs during the class exhibitions. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 1.1.1Attentive Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and Imagination: The learner embraces creative ideas when making presentations based on the theme.

● Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner builds on their own learning experiences when listening to peer

presentations and gives peer review.

Values:
● Unity: This is developed as the learner works with peers harmoniously to sing songs.

● Responsibility: It is acquired as the learner takes initiative to make a presentation using vocabulary identified.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Talent development and nurturing: This is promoted as the learner sing songs used for different ceremonies and festivals.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to learn and relate the concept of singing to their learning of performance in Creative Arts.
